en: The image is a colored historical postcard depicting a large red-brick military barracks building, with multiple uniformed men and officers standing and chatting in front. The architecture is late 19th- or early 20th-century, typical of German military installations. The text at the top identifies the building and its use as a barracks for certain companies of the 13th Infantry Regiment in Kamenz.
